cues.narration: His grandfather takes him through the systems that keep their city alive.

scenes.title: The switch in the system

cues.narration: This speculative story makes immense questions small enough to ask across a kitchen table.
cues.visualAction: Return to a small table where the questions remain understandable.

scenes.title: A child keeps asking
scenes.viewerPurpose: Enjoy the child noticing what adults miss Join a future that still has disagreements
